title: Mårék's Known Region

current_position.state: Year 375, early summer; Journey Day 4 from Valek; just after midday / early afternoon; Mårék is in Dāren Ford after the Deren surveillance and Meln report

authority.source: Private GM authority Mershmen83/M-r-k-full-gm-campaign through CP101; public map contains Mårék-known in-world facts only

coordinate_model.warning: Coordinates are renderer placement aids only. They are not canonical measurements unless a feature's spatial_basis says locked. Observed route order and explicit relations are canon; display placement does not establish exact mileage or unresolved compass bearings. Rell Quarry placement is schematic from reported northwest relation and is not direct observation.

known_facts: Fresh wagon rut turned left off the main road when traveling west

features.name: Thieves' Wagon Hollow
known_facts: Hidden grassy hollow where Rask/red-arm and two other thieves were found

features.name: Split Boulder
known_facts: Broad split boulder marks the narrow track to the broken-roof stash shed

features.name: Broken-roof Stash Shed
known_facts: Old broken-roof stone shed used as Rask/Kerr stash
Recovered caches included silver, goods, victim effects and papers

features.name: Teren Ambush Site
known_facts: Teren was found wounded in the right-side ditch after a loose saddled Drāv appeared in the road
One deliberate firing position was found behind a pale stone on the right side

features.name: Broad Shallow Ford
known_facts: Broad shallow stony crossing personally observed on Journey Day 2

features.name: Old Stone Wayhouse
known_facts: Ruined pale-stone wayhouse with most of the roof gone
Recent bootmarks, cold ash and deliberately left travel gear showed recent use

features.name: Teren / Saren Care Farm
known_facts: Modest farmstead left of the westbound road after lower wet ground
Teren was left alive here with Saren and a week of care paid

features.name: Day 3 Road Junction
known_facts: First proper junction observed since Meren Junction
Rāvik sign later read: Dāren Ford straight west; Rellin Farms left

features.name: Dāren Ford
known_facts: Broad-river town reached on Journey Day 3
Organic irregular lanes and patched serviceable buildings
Farms blend into town economy
Freight/storage/loading activity increases toward river
Multiple ferry operations along south bank
No continuous defensive wall observed from approach

features.name: Dāren South Ferry Yard
known_facts: More-established south-bank ferry/freight yard
Recovered meeting note led here
Meln was directly contacted here

features.name: Old Dāren Stash Shed
known_facts: Old storage sheds on south-east edge of Dāren
Former Rask-associated concealed stash point
Second three-lines-under-curve token recovered

features.name: Deren's East-River Freight House
known_facts: Deren observed here during Journey Day 4 morning
Main yard, side-lane door and rear river access observed

features.name: West-River Contact Warehouse
known_facts: Long low warehouse with small attached street-side office
Deren's dark-coated contact entered here
Observed side-door signal: two quick knocks, pause, one knock
Ownership/function unknown

features.name: Rell Quarry

travel.time: roughly half a day from Dāren by Meln's report

known_facts: Old quarry country; quarry reported no longer active
Surrounding country used by shepherds and sometimes hunters
Reports of bright/falling light beyond ridge and thunder-like sound despite no storm
Report of strange footprints near old quarry road
Report of a strange-speaking person walking the road the following morning
Not yet visited by Mårék
